data.one_liner: Auth0 SDK for Flutter to integrate Auth0 authentication into mobile, desktop, and web apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs for user authentication, token management, social logins, and passkeys across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and web applications using the Auth0 platform.
use_when: You need to authenticate users via Auth0 in a Flutter app.
Your application targets multiple platforms including mobile, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: You are using a backend other than Auth0 for authentication.
You do not want to configure native callback URLs and deep links.
strengths: Cross-platform support spanning Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and web.
Supports modern features like passkeys and token management.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for custom URL schemes and manifest placeholders.
CocoaPods builds stay on an older version of Auth0.swift and do not support newer features.
data.setup_notes: Requires Auth0 dashboard application creation, redirect URI configurations, Android manifest placeholders, and platform-specific setup for URL schemes.
